newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: SLOVAK C.BANK SAYS NEW BOARD APPROVES TWO MEASURES.
newsitem.headline: SLOVAK C.BANK SAYS NEW BOARD APPROVES TWO MEASURES.

text.p: The National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) governing board on Friday said it had approved two measures at its regular governing board meeting.

The NBS said in a statement the board approved a "practical framework" for the project "risk management and an open foreign exchange position", and a project named "registry of bank loans and guarantees".

"The (first) project creates conditions for an automated system of securing and assessment of data necessary for the management of risk introduced by an open foreign exchange position and the monetary structure of foreign exchange assests and liabilities," the statement said.
The NBS will operate using the system from April 30.
"The (registry) project will secure technological and programme conditions for automating the bank loan registry and guarantees registration," the statement added.
The statement did not include any further details.
NBS officials were not immediately available for comment.

Slovak interbank money market dealers have been closely watching for a possible reverse repo rate cut or some administrative measures after Prime Minister Vladimir Meciar's statement earlier this week that measures would be taken to lower rates.
